_comment: Settings of scripts\Benchmark-Models.ps1. 'models' are profile names from config\models.json, 'tasks' are folders in benchmark\tasks\. 'workDir' is where the agent solves the tasks (empty = <installRoot>\bench-work); it must lie outside this repository, otherwise Claude Code loads the repository's CLAUDE.md into every task. 'allowedTools' are the commands the agent may run without a person to confirm them. 'taskTimeoutSeconds' overrides 'agentTimeoutSeconds' for single tasks.
